summary: Max Verstappen won the São Paulo Grand Prix Sprint from P2 on the grid, 4.3s ahead of Lando Norris, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
Lance Stroll made the biggest climb, from P17 to P12.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P18.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 253 points over Sergio Perez.
